page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.n2.xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 8 dedicated physical cores on an x86_64 architecture, utilizing an Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at a base frequency of 2.5 GHz. The instance is configured with 32.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware.

Performance benchmarks indicate a clear distinction between single-threaded and multi-threaded execution. Single-core performance is relatively weak, with stress-ng and Geekbench single-core scores falling into the bottom 25% and 10% respectively. However, multi-core performance scales to average levels, as demonstrated by a Geekbench multi-core score of 4895.0 and a Passmark CPU score of 9929.97. Memory bandwidth remains stable in the average tier, reaching 61.2 GB/sec for large block read operations and 47.14 GB/sec for write operations.

The primary tradeoff of this instance is its low single-threaded throughput, which affects tasks like single-threaded compression and text processing. Conversely, it handles parallelized workloads more effectively, achieving 10.22 million operations per second in Redis SET benchmarks and average performance in software compilation. This profile makes the instance suitable for general-purpose multi-threaded workloads, basic web serving, Redis caching, and development environments that do not require high single-core clock speeds or local NVMe storage.
